name: pm
description: PM helpers for team Linear workflows. Skills for single-ticket authoring (a short shaping interview, body composed to the shared issue-body spec), the weekly grooming loop (per-person WIP), plan-to-tickets breakdown (assignee-aware), chart-first mapping of efforts too large to plan in one session, questionnaires that pull a blocking decision out of someone else's head, and end-of-cycle retro notes (attribution + Linear-first output). Composes with the linear plugin; ndr and librarian integrations are optional externals.
